title: unified-rollouts-add-probing-shadow-canary-autorollback-workflow
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: We need a safer rollout primitive to validate new model variants under production traffic patterns before shifting live traffic. This PR introduces a "probing" stage for unified rollouts that combines low-volume shadow traffic probing, metric quorum checks, and an automatic rollback trigger when the probe fails thresholds. The probing stage sits between the initial canary/shadow phases and full rollout, allowing teams to verify stability signals (latency P95, error-rate, and semantic-quality regressions via synthetic prompt probes) with an explicit quorum and timeout. What this PR does (high level): - Adds a probing stage controller that dispatches synthetic probe requests to candidate variants (shadowed) and aggregates results into a quorum-aware decision. - Extends the autorollback engine to accept composite probe results and apply weighted decisions based on multiple metrics. - Adds observability: new rollout_probe_* metrics, tracing spans for probe lifecycles, and per-rollout probe dashboards. - Adds integration and e2e tests that simulate common failure modes (latency spike, error surge, semantic drift) and assert rollback behavior. - Adds config knobs: probe_interval, probe_quorum, probe_timeout, composite_metric_weights. Defaults are conservative: probe_quorum=3, probe_timeout=30s, probe_interval=10s. - Migration: rollout controller gracefully ignores probing config for older rollout specs; new rollouts opt-in via spec.probing.enabled. Implementation notes: - controller/probing_stage.go implements a finite-state probing worker that schedules N probes across candidate variants and computes weighted scores. - autorollback_engine.go extended to accept ProbeDecision objects (serialized as compact protobufs at the controller boundary) and to attach rollback reason metadata for audit logs. - Metrics are implemented in pkg/metrics/rollback_metrics.go and exposed via /metrics. Dashboards added under observability-pack/dashboards/rollout_probes.json. - e2e tests added under integration-tests/rollouts/probing_canary_test.py that run against the local canary runtime using the test harness. - Docs: docs/rollouts/probing-shadow-canary.md documents workflow and sample configs. Checklist: - [x] RFC and design discussion (ENG-1429) - [x] Unit tests for probe scoring logic - [x] Integration/e2e tests covering success, partial quorum, and failure - [x] Metrics and tracing added - [x] Docs and Sample configs - [x] Migration compatibility with older specs - [x] Load soak in perf-canary (limited run) Testing and CI: - Initial CI run failed on integration e2e due to a timing flake in the test harness (probe timeout race). Root cause: harness didn't mock clock; fixed by adding deterministic test clock to the harness and retry logic for ephemeral ports. - Final CI: all checks passed (unit, linters, integration, e2e, and perf smoke). - Manual QA: deployed to a staging cluster with a simulated workload (see Linear ticket ENG-1587 for playbook). Observed correct rollback on injected latency spike and successful promotion on clean probe results. Rollout plan for this feature: - Feature gated behind rollout.spec.probing.enabled (opt-in) for one release. - Start with internal teams (platform and SRE) for 2 weeks. - Monitor rollout_probe_failures and rollback_safety_alerts. - After validation, flip default to enabled in 2-3 releases. Related: ENG-1429 design doc, ENG-1587 QA playbook, several previous autorollback PRs (see PRs referencing the unified-rollouts stack).
